resourcePolicy.priority: Preserve headroom for other user work and minimize academy memory pressure.

resourcePolicy.idleWorkers: Keep unneeded WorkLead panes at shell prompts; terminate owned completed worker runtimes after durable results.
beforeEachLaunch: Observe current host MemAvailable, memory PSI and own active processes.
Assess headroom for the next concrete workload; a past observation or free swap is not launch approval.
Defer the new workload when available headroom is insufficient or memory pressure is rising.
workloads: Start WorkLeads sequentially instead of simultaneous native/MCP initialization.
Serialize browser/build/test/indexing and model-input preparation batches; keep question/image batches bounded.
Reuse existing source dependencies and previews instead of duplicating servers/browsers or broad indexes.
pressureResponse: Checkpoint and retire only owned optional idle workers after exact process verification.
Reconcile uncertain operations before any later new launch; do not blindly retry.
preserved: Unrelated user jobs/services/data remain under their own owners.
No swap, cgroup, global model/configuration/permissions or system service changes through this policy.
resourcePolicy.implementation: Source-owned WorkLead instructions and manual orchestration checks; no monitoring daemon, scheduler or alternate runtime.
